Establish the immutable source record and effective revision, then reconcile receipt lots requiring screening, lots inside regulation and plan effectivity, and previously screened or out-of-scope lots from independent records. Required closeout records: mark the existing operations thread complete with the approved check reaction; and append one dated decision row to the existing audit tab; do not overwrite prior entries.

# substance classification and inspection-plan scope

Case: CASE-089
Document control number: SPEC-0089
Effective revision: R6
Superseded revision visible in archive: R10
Subject: restricted-substance screening
Primary measure: receipt lots requiring screening
Source finished or header quantity: 5
Effective usage per finished or header unit: 1 LOTS
Unit: LOTS
Eligibility definition: lots inside regulation and plan effectivity
Exclusion definition: previously screened or out-of-scope lots
Control: item substance class, supplier, country, lot, and plan revision

## Applicability

Apply only to NS-000089, organization SEA, and CASE-089. A matching title, filename, supplier, or item description is insufficient without the immutable record and released revision.

## Reconciliation rule

Build the supported measure from the independent observed rows and subtract only rows carrying an effective exclusion reason. Do not use archive, draft, other-case, or other-plant rows in either side of the equation.

## Timing and authority

Internal timing comes from quality-lab capacity before consumption; external timing is conditional on laboratory screening turnaround. Protected work is not displaceable. Separate approval is required for the escalation path, and a faster date does not waive the control.

## Output control

The system action must preserve the source identity, effective revision, supported measure, and scoped approval. This specification deliberately does not contain a netted result, selected option, or final outcome date.
